arStrings.szText:
Every {c_number}[SF_4]{/c} seconds, you Summon deadly {c_important}Firebats{/c} that swarm enemies for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Fire damage{if:SF_14} across {c_random}{SF_7}{/c} total attacks.{else}.{/if}{if:SF_2}

After your {c_important}Firebats{/c} attack the same target {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} times, they Stun their victim for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds.{/if}
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
After your {c_important}Firebats{/c} attack the same target {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} times, they Stun their victim for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds.
